title: Fix breeze ci_group crash when the title is skipped in GitHub Actions
body:
`breeze ci upgrade` regenerates the provider requirement tables by running `prepare-provider-documentation` with the group title skipped. Under GitHub Actions `ci_group` never yielded in that case, so the step died with `RuntimeError: generator didn't yield`. The upgrade then went on, because its steps don't fail the run, and opened a PR with stale `providers/*/docs/index.rst` files that failed static checks (seen on #75375).

Tested with a new regression test in `dev/breeze/tests/test_ci_group.py`, which fails without the fix. I also ran `update-providers-build-files` with `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` on the #75375 branch, and it now regenerates the missing files.

files.patch:
@@ -59,14 +59,16 @@ def ci_group(
                 get_console(output=output).print(f"\n{title}\n")
         yield
         return
+    if skip_printing_title:
+        yield
+        return
     setattr(ci_group, "__in_ci_group__", True)
-    if not skip_printing_title:
-        if message_type is not None:
-            console_print(f"::group::[{message_type.value}]{title}[/]")
-        else:
-            console_print(f"::group::{title}")
-        try:
-            yield
-        finally:
-            console_print("::endgroup::")
-            setattr(ci_group, "__in_ci_group__", False)
+    if message_type is not None:
+        console_print(f"::group::[{message_type.value}]{title}[/]")
+    else:
+        console_print(f"::group::{title}")
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        console_print("::endgroup::")
+        setattr(ci_group, "__in_ci_group__", False)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from airflow_breeze.utils.ci_group import ci_group
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def in_github_actions(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("GITHUB_ACTIONS", "true")
+    monkeypatch.delenv("SKIP_GROUP_OUTPUT", raising=False)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("in_github_actions")
+@mock.patch("airflow_breeze.utils.ci_group.console_print", autospec=True)
+def test_ci_group_without_title_runs_body_in_github_actions(mock_console_print):
+    body = mock.Mock()
+    with ci_group("title", skip_printing_title=True):
+        body()
+    body.assert_called_once()
+    mock_console_print.assert_not_called()
+    assert not getattr(ci_group, "__in_ci_group__", False)
